mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing skin and blood renewal together made it clear that the constructed body keeps replacing cells, rather than staying finished and unchanged.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final bone-forming step was straightforward after the patch was cleared, so it felt more like completing an obvious sequence than making a new decision.

surprise.text: I expected the bone-removing and bone-forming cells to combine directly; the hint instead paired the removing cells with the body first.

arbitrary.text: The need to start bone removal on the body was not obvious to me beforehand, although clearing a patch before filling it makes sense afterward.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the body changes over time, though this chapter's mostly direct pairings left limited room for decisions.
